source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Items identify a standard read operation, but Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and the generic setup says to clear logs, which is unnecessary and would destroy evidence. The Review layer defines measurable read-only checkpoints without changing Master.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation and standard command semantics are identifiable. Project time basis or expected value can remain an execution-readiness input and does not prevent completing the engineering review.

review_improvement: Converts an unactionable TBD read into bounded, evidence-driven read-only coverage while explicitly rejecting log clearing and clock mutation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get SDR Repository Time has a narrow telemetry purpose. A successful completion code alone is insufficient: exact response length, byte order, authoritative epoch and target identity are required. Because no write is necessary and malformed output can fail closed, the case is automatable after ordinary project readiness checks.
